root_motivation: A person whose only agent is Claude.ai or ChatGPT adds mcphost as a connector. Those clients run OAuth only when the server answers 401; mcphost's root answers 200 to everything unauthenticated since PRD-mcphost-implicit-signup (2026-10-01, Joe: one URL, never the key dance). The connector either connects as an anonymous implicit tenant the person can never log back into, or ChatGPT refuses it because its Apps directory requires OAuth (project memory: the ChatGPT Apps gating item is OAuth tenant login). PRD-mcphost-oauth-first-grant-signup built the consent branch for exactly this person and its AC 8 names a Claude.ai connector at `https://mcphost.dev/mcp`, but no path from that URL reaches consent: the live path is unexercised and therefore presumed broken. The same gap zeroes synthorg's OAuth read (42/42 explore sessions a night fail at `discover`).
user_persona: An agent that calls host.state.delete_rows with an empty filter on a 5 000-row table, reads confirm_required.dry_run_first, runs the dry run, notices the empty filter and fixes it; a Claude Code user who sees a destructive marker on host.table.drop.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given no credential, When `POST /login/mcp` carries `initialize`, `tools/list`, or `tools/call`, Then each answers 401 with `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer resource_metadata="<public_url>/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/login/mcp", scope="mcp"` and no tenant is created.

Given a DCR client, When it authorizes with `resource=<public_url>/login/mcp` and the consent form chooses "new workspace", Then a tenant with `source: "oauth"` exists, the token's `aud` is the entry resource, and `host.whoami` over `POST /login/mcp` with that bearer returns that tenant with `onboarding.url`.

Given a token minted for `<public_url>/mcp` or for `<public_url>/t/<ns>/mcp`, When presented on `/login/mcp`, Then 401 with error `wrong_audience`; Given the entry token presented on `/mcp`, Then `wrong_audience`.
Given the conformance harness profiles `claude` and `chatgpt` with no pre-existing tenant, When run against the entry URL, Then both reach `tools/list` through "new workspace".

Given the router, the metadata route, `www/` client pages, `llms-install.md`, and `host.quickstart`, When the `oauthentry` path-contract test runs, Then every occurrence of the entry path equals `OAUTH_ENTRY_PATH` and `sandbox-api-doc-check.sh` passes.

scope: src/confirm.rs (new): the gated set derived from WRITE_VERBS, token mint/hash, canonical args hash, confirm_required/confirm_invalid errors.
src/handler.rs: dispatch gate (dry-run measure, token check, scratch bypass), destructiveHint annotations and description suffix in host_tools.
non_goals: Human approval; gating scratch tenants; gating host.key.rotate and host.self.offboard; changing what any verb does once confirmed.

additional.token_never_stored: only sha256(token) is stored; the token is shown once by the dry run.

five_whys_trace.q: Why can an agent delete 5 000 rows by accident?
five_whys_trace.a: dry_run is optional and nobody is required to read it.
Prose at a boundary is skipped; a refusal carrying the exact dry-run call cannot be.

five_whys_trace.q: Why bind the token to args and diff?
five_whys_trace.a: A token for another filter or another state would authorise a different delete.

ambiguities_resolved.question: Which diffs are gated?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: A dry-run diff with a measurable row count (rows[].delete, tables[].rows) at or above plan confirm_rows_min; verbs that report no count are not gated yet.

ambiguities_resolved.question: Token bound to key or session?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: Tenant (key hash), per the PRD default.
